title: The Philadelphia Experiment
dek: The claim that the USS Eldridge was made invisible and teleported from Philadelphia to Norfolk in 1943, resting almost entirely on one correspondent.

facts.asserted: October 1943 at the Philadelphia Navy Yard

prose.label: The claim
prose.body: That in October 1943 the USS Eldridge was rendered invisible at the Philadelphia Navy Yard, teleported to Norfolk and back, and that crew members were fused into the deck on its return.

prose.label: Supports
prose.body: Carl Allen, writing as Carlos Miguel Allende, sent annotated letters to the Office of Naval Research in 1956 describing the event as an eyewitness aboard a nearby ship.

prose.label: Contradicts
prose.body: The Eldridge's deck log places her elsewhere for the period in question. Allen later told investigators he had imagined the account. No second witness has been produced.

image_credit: USS Eldridge photographs are public-domain Navy imagery when attached.
